actions.name: Deploy Windows-specific Megazord ransomware and Akira_v2 ESXi encryptor concurrently

actions.name: Exfiltrate data using tools such as FileZilla, WinRAR, WinSCP, and RClone

actions.name: Establish command and control channels using AnyDesk, MobaXterm, RustDesk, Ngrok, and Cloudflare Tunnel
actions.description: Akira threat actors use legitimate remote access and tunneling tools to establish command and control channels enabling exfiltration.

actions.name: Encrypt systems using hybrid encryption scheme combining ChaCha20 and RSA
actions.description: Akira threat actors encrypt data using a sophisticated hybrid encryption scheme combining ChaCha20 stream cipher with RSA public-key cryptosystem, appending .akira or .powerranges extensions.

actions.name: Delete volume shadow copies on Windows systems using PowerShell commands
actions.description: Akira encryptor (w.exe) uses PowerShell commands to delete volume shadow copies (VSS) on Windows systems to inhibit system recovery.

actions.name: Use Akira_v2 encryptor with runtime arguments and protections
actions.description: Akira_v2 encryptor written in Rust includes runtime arguments for targeted paths, encryption percentage, process forking, thread control, and uses Build ID as a run condition to hinder dynamic analysis.

actions.name: Use Akira_v2 encryptor functionalities to target only virtual machines and stop running VMs
actions.description: Akira_v2 encryptor has 'vmonly' to deploy against only virtual machines and 'stopvm' to stop running virtual machines.
